meta.title: 동명극장 재개관
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (동명극장, a single-screen cinema reopening (fictional)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Sepia film: everything is drawn in browns from #1E1812 to cream #F4EAD2 and multiplied by a warm tint; only the bulbs glow warm yellow #FFE6A0 and #F2C46A; intertitles are cream on near-black #100C08.
rationale.type: Nanum Myeongjo ExtraBold, the serif of old Korean cinema posters and intertitles, centred on the cards and set as subtitles under the pictures.
rationale.motion: The projector, not the camera: the frame weaves every film frame (18 a second), the exposure flickers, grain crawls, scratches and dust pass; the leader counts down on the beats; bulbs light one at a time, then chase; cards cut on the bar.
rationale.sound: Swing at 128 BPM in Bb major (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): piano comping, walking upright bass, clarinet, ride and brushes; a beep on each countdown number, a soft thud for the cards.
rationale.visuals: All code: a countdown leader with a clock wipe and crosshair, intertitle cards with double borders and corner flourishes, a brick front with a bulb sign and a marquee, a projector with turning reels and a dusty beam, a film pass (tint, flicker, grain, scratches, dust, a hair, an iris vignette).
rationale.narration: Not recommended: it is a silent-film look.
